personality_one_liner: A high-octane, neon-drenched arcade clicker that demands pure reaction speed.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use glass for the Game Over bottom sheet modal
Use glass for the Home screen sticky header/duration selector backdrop
Use glass for combo pop-ups if they overlay dense elements
dont's: Do not use glass for the moving target shapes (they must be solid neon for visibility)
Do not use glass on simple buttons

haptics.NO_TOLERANCE: always have switcher in settings or profile page
haptics.wiring: Haptic calls live inside these components (Button primary, TabBar item, SegmentedControl, FilterChip, switch, slider) they fire automatically on use. Dev agent does NOT wire haptics ad-hoc per screen.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Landing screen to choose duration via a fixed chip row and start the game. Displays highest score.

states.empty: No high score yet? Show a vibrant 'Play your first game' graphic.

screens.name: Game
screens.purpose: The main reaction arena. Score at the top, countdown timer, and a randomly teleporting shape that changes geometry (Circle, Square, Triangle, Star, Hexagon) on each click.

screens.name: GameOver Modal
screens.purpose: A glassmorphic BottomSheet or Modal overlaying the game. Shows final score, max combo, and celebrates new high scores.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Dark-First Utility' (Personality 7) rules.
NO BLUE OR PURPLE ALLOWED. Use the provided Coral Red, Volt Green, and Neon Orange tokens exclusively for color.
Implement the 'chip_row' pattern strictly for the Game Duration selector (10s, 20s, 30s) on the Home screen. It must sit under the Sticky Header as chrome, using fixed height of 36pt.

For the Game Screen target, use Phosphor icons (Circle, Square, Triangle, Star, Hexagon) or pure SVGs, rendering them with a large size (e.g., 64-96pt) and applying `shadowColor: theme.brandPrimary`, `shadowRadius: 15` (or `expo-blur`) for a neon glow effect. Rotate the shape randomly on each tap.

Ensure `useWindowDimensions()` is used to calculate random X/Y positioning for the target so it never clips off-screen. Apply `SafeArea` insets to the bounds calculations so the target doesn't hide behind the notch/island.
Implement haptics on target hits (`impact_medium`) and for streak combos (`notification_success`).
Persist high score via AsyncStorage. Trigger the 'New High Score!' celebration in the Game Over modal using animations.

chip_row.rules: Fixed 36pt height, 56pt row height, horizontal scroll only, sits outside scrollable list as a sibling in the sticky header stack.
